2) A clear timeline linking milestones to contract sign-off (we need the procurement checklist to show date windows).

Subject: Re: POC go/no-go rubric and MAP milestones for Integris POC

Samira — thanks, this is exactly the right level of ask. Drafting a compact MAP and an acceptance rubric now; attached a PDF with the proposed pass/conditional/fail thresholds plus an editable MAP workbook that maps tasks to owners and dates. Highlights below so your packet team can paste directly into the approval doc: 

- Acceptance rubric (summary):
  * Pass: model meets >= 92% clinical-accuracy on annotated validation set AND median inference latency <= 350ms at 1 rps, no critical safety regressions.
  * Conditional pass: 88-91% accuracy OR latency 350-500ms — requires remediation sprint and a follow-up 2-week verification window.
  * Fail: <88% accuracy OR any critical safety regression (false positive rate on adverse-event detection > 3%).

- Exit gates (must all be satisfied for sign-off):
  1) Data ingest and preprocessing pipeline validated end-to-end with a representative sample.
  2) Security annex & SOC2 snapshot reviewed by Integris security.
  3) Performance within SLA on your staging infra (latency & throughput).
  4) No unresolved P1/P2 issues from the evaluation test suite.

- Suggested test suite (attached sample-eval-queries.txt): functional coverage, edge-case prompts, throughput/latency sweeps, privacy/PII redaction checks, and a small adversarial set.

- Proposed timeline (high level):
  * Feb 16–22: MAP signoff, environment staging, data handoff
  * Feb 23–Mar 5: evaluation run daily batches + early fixes (if conditional pass)
  * Mar 7: target pilot onboarding / handover to Integris ops

I attached: poc-acceptance-rubric.pdf and integris_map_v2.xlsx (editable). Let us know where to place the DocuSign for the MAP approval or if you prefer a single-line approval email.

Thanks — sending to Aditya and Marissa to confirm capacity and any blockers on our side.

—Olga
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Quick internal note — read Olga's draft and the thresholds look appropriately conservative for a clinical pilot. A couple operational notes we should finalize before sending the updated MAP to Integris: 

1) Verification window: propose we make the remediation verification 10 business days (not 14) to keep the schedule tight, unless Integris requests longer.
2) Load profile: Marissa, can we commit to 1 rps sustained with 3x burst for the staging run? If not, we need to adjust the latency SLO in the rubric.
3) Security evidence: Rishi — can you pull the latest SOC2 snapshot and KMS integration notes for the security annex? Integris will want a specific audit date.

I'll prepare a one-page executive summary for the procurement packet that maps the acceptance rubric rows to who signs each gate. Olga — want me to post that into the MAP workbook?

Aditya
